recent_tweets.text:
exploring ways to spin up agents from my phone

iOS shortcuts × github actions × cursor cli

world_signals: whispers that weighty models could live next door instead of on someone else's farm
open inference projects braiding their clocks in public
late may light leaning long over the pacific
pocket shortcuts wiring agents while the city hums
spring air still cool before the real heat arrives

composer-2-fast.concept: Catch only the micro-gaps in a stutter-house pattern while fake downbeats try to bait you — score comes from the off-grid hush, not the obvious pulse.
composer-2-fast.mechanic: Rhythm tap on intentionally wrong-looking beats; only the stutter-silences count.
composer-2-fast.session_hook: One clean 30s pass feels like you learned a secret handshake with the track.
composer-2-fast.escalation: Ghost beats and tempo creep multiply; the grid visually lies more each bar.
composer-2-fast.aesthetic: neon oscilloscope traces on deep black

gpt-5.5-extra-high.concept: Flick soft moon-jelly tokens across a dream-pop gradient so they settle in glowing wells without shattering.
gpt-5.5-extra-high.mechanic: Physics flick with sticky/splat outcomes based on angle and spin.
gpt-5.5-extra-high.session_hook: A single perfect arc and soft landing is its own tiny encore.
gpt-5.5-extra-high.escalation: Wells shrink, gravity tilts sideways, surfaces get slick.
gpt-5.5-extra-high.aesthetic: washed watercolor fog and pearlescent bloom

claude-opus-4-7-thinking-max.concept: Drag one continuous ink line through a chorus-shaped maze; the ink dries into walls behind you, so you cannot reuse paths.
claude-opus-4-7-thinking-max.mechanic: Path drawing with self-blocking geometry that hardens as you move.
claude-opus-4-7-thinking-max.session_hook: Closing the loop before the ink seals the last exit is a sharp micro-puzzle.
claude-opus-4-7-thinking-max.escalation: Drying speeds up and the singable window shortens each round.
claude-opus-4-7-thinking-max.aesthetic: paper cutout pastels and matte ink

gemini-3.1-pro.concept: Three-lane spring cleaning for a tiny agent desk — sort ambiguous task chips (bug, feature, doc, noise) before the inbox overflows.
gemini-3.1-pro.mechanic: Lane switch plus tap-to-commit sorting under time pressure.
gemini-3.1-pro.touch_control: swipe between lanes, tap to file
gemini-3.1-pro.session_hook: Clearing the board in one focused minute feels like inbox zero in miniature.
gemini-3.1-pro.escalation: Spawn rate rises and labels blur or stack multi-tagged chips.
gemini-3.1-pro.aesthetic: terminal chrome with soft mint spring accents
